editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding out your relative left you something far more disturbing than money or land. That is exactly what happens when you meet Lana, a woman who discovers her uncle had a secret life involving human trafficking. Instead of doing the right thing and calling the police, she decides to take over the business for herself. You will see her transition from a regular person into a cold boss who pimps out two sex slaves to make a quick buck. The vibe is dark, gritty, and honestly pretty uncomfortable, as you watch her lose her soul for the sake of greed.

The acting is surprisingly strong, making Lana's shift into a villain feel real and scary. While the story moves a bit slow in the middle, the tension builds up well as her lies start to catch up with her. If you like movies that show the darkest parts of human nature, this one is for you.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when Lana's greed pushes her too far. The movie ends with the cycle of abuse coming full circle. As the girls try to escape and the legal walls close in, you see that Lana has become exactly like the uncle she once looked down on. There is no happy ending here; instead, it wraps up with a cold reminder that people who exploit others eventually lose everything they care about.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological dramas about crime and morality.
